newsitem.title: USA: Plains feedlot cattle trade nil after flurry - trade.
newsitem.headline: Plains feedlot cattle trade nil after flurry - trade.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle markets were quiet following Wednesday's active sales, feedlot sources said.
Feedlot managers indicated they had sold most of their showlists by the end of Wednesday. Cattle generally sold at a top price of $72.00 per cwt, up $1.00 from last week.

Prices were lifted by strong meat packer demand to fill orders booked by retailers for beef promotions to go alongside turkey features for Thanksgiving, market sources said. Planned beef features after the holiday also were expected to keep retail buyers in the market, they said.
